name: Tubular Heat Exchanger
full_description: ViEX describes its tubular heat exchanger as a shell-and-tube heat exchanger with mature design, manufacturing, inspection, and maintenance technology, wide material choice, and broad application conditions. The official page says the company holds Chinese pressure vessel D1 and D2 design and manufacturing licenses and focuses on enhanced heat transfer shell-and-tube exchangers using arc tubes, corrugated tubes, spiral tubes, plasma tubes, three-dimensional rib tubes, baffle tubes, and spiral baffles to improve efficiency and reduce pressure loss.
advantage: High temperature and high pressure resistance
Wide material selection and broad duty coverage
Mature design, manufacturing, and maintenance technology
Improved efficiency and reduced resistance loss

technical_parameters.Licenses: Pressure vessel D1 and D2 design and manufacturing licenses
technical_parameters.Product types: Fixed tubesheet; U-tube; Floating head; Stuffing box
technical_parameters.Enhanced elements: Arc tube; Corrugated tube; Spiral tube; Plasma tube; 3D rib tube; Baffle tube; Spiral baffle plate

details.title: How does ViEX classify the product?
details.content: The official page introduces four main structural types: fixed tubesheet, U-tube, floating head, and stuffing box shell-and-tube heat exchangers.

details.title: What industries are highlighted?
details.content: The product page points to petroleum refining, chemical industry, electric power, metallurgy, and water conservancy among the main application areas.

seo_data.meta_description: Shell-and-tube heat exchanger designed for high-temperature, high-pressure, and enhanced heat transfer industrial applications.
